about_short_description.short_description: Numen develops software for electronic document management and digitalization.

product.name: Doxtreem
product.description: A cloud-based electronic document management system that centralizes, organizes, and secures digital documents for businesses and public sector organizations.

product.name: Numen CFN Pro
product.description: A professional digital safe solution for secure electronic archiving and long-term preservation of documents with legal compliance.

product.name: Numen Express
product.description: An online platform for managing and sending personalized outgoing mail and transactional documents efficiently.

product.name: Numen Éditique Industrielle
product.description: A mass document production and distribution platform for automated generation and sending of outgoing transactional documents.

product.name: Numen Data Extract
product.description: A data extraction tool integrated with document management to automatically identify and capture key information from business documents.

product.name: Numen Prestations Archivistiques
product.description: Archival services for managing, preserving, and securing physical and digital documents according to regulatory standards.
